pages.text: An activated scroll becomes the catalyst for replication or transformation. Its hexagonal slot diagram appears in the center of the crucible HUD and turns hidden knowledge into an experiment.

pages.title: Operating Steps
pages.text: $(li)Drop the activated scroll as catalyst into the empty crucible.$(li)Drop in the item shown on the scroll's left side. If a Sigil has no left-side input, skip it.$(li)Fill each essence slot.$(li)The reaction begins. Right-click the crucible to collect all outputs.

pages.title: Reaction Mechanism
pages.text: Each slot has a target essence. Insert the same essence and it $(term)annihilates$(): the input vanishes, the target is revealed, and the scroll loses durability.$(br2)Insert a different essence and it reacts normally: the input changes state according to the rules, while the state change of the "virtual" target is reflected as a change to the crucible's polarity.

pages.title: Success and Failure
pages.text: Only when all essences are fully annihilated can the final item appear. Otherwise, the transformed essence metals remain as outputs. Recover them, study the results, and try again.
